tables.title: Application for Patent in Fee - Question and Answer Summary

rows.Question: Age?
Degree of blood?
Married or single?
Did you attend school? If so, where and how long?
Do you use intoxicants?
rows.Answer: Yes, but to a small extent

rows.Question: Are you in good physical condition?
What is the value of the land covered by your application?
Does your application cover your own allotment or inherited land?
Does your application cover all or a part of your land?
Do you cultivate your land?
Have you any other occupation?
Are you self-supporting? If so, how is your self-support obtained?
Have you accumulated any property? If so, what?
Are you in debt? If so, whom do you owe, how much, and for what, and have you given security for the debts?
rows.Answer: Yes, Matt Bully one thousand dollars for thirty-five head of heifers, I have given security

rows.Question: Have you been given a patent in fee for a part of your land? If so, did you sell it, and what use did you make of the proceeds of the sale?
Have you any inherited land? If so, what is your interest in the estate and what is the value of the allotment?
Have you sold any inherited land? If so, what use was made of the proceeds?
Have you any individual Indian money to your credit with the superintendent? If so, how much?
rows.Answer: Some money issued while I was not on roll

rows.Question: Have you been given the privilege of leasing your own land?
Is your land leased? If so, what rent do you receive?
rows.Answer: No, I use it myself for hay land

rows.Question: Have you made a contract to sell your land? If so, to whom, and at what price?
Has anyone asked you to procure a patent in fee for the purpose of disposing of your land?
Have other members of your family allotments of their own? If so, give names, sex, ages, relationship, and number of acres, and approximate value of each allotment.
rows.Answer: Yes. Cecilia Sully, girl, 2.5 years, my daughter, 160 acres valued about $1600

rows.Question: What members of your family, if any, have no allotment? Designate those dependent on you for support, and give reasons, stating ages and sex.
rows.Answer: Howard Sully, son, age 1 year, allotment asked for but agent did not attend to it

rows.Question: What practical business experience have you had?
Have you other lands that would continue to be held in trust after the lands described in this application are released? If so, give acreage, value, and character of improvements thereon.
Set forth fully your reasons for requesting a patent in fee.
rows.Answer: So that I can have the same privilege in buying and selling land as any other citizen
